svg.aria-label: Nothing gets lost in claude-obsidian: Claude reads the notes it will change, records their hashes and applies one recoverable transaction. When the power cuts out mid-write the journal rolls the vault back, and when you edit a note in Obsidian at the same time a conflict stops the write instead of overwriting your edit.

svg.text: Every change is one recoverable transaction.
